svg.title: What Goes Into One Request
svg.desc: One request is a stack. The system prompt, set by the app, holds role, scope, tone and output format. Grounding adds source text with the instruction to answer only from it, otherwise say you don't know. A few-shot example guides format for this request only and doesn't retrain the model. Earlier turns are resent because each request stands alone. The user prompt is today's task. The model then returns a grounded reply that matches your data and admits gaps. Adding "always be accurate" and raising the temperature never fixes fabrication.
svg.text: The system prompt sets the rules; grounding stops fabrication; the user prompt is today's task.
Role, scope, tone, output format: set by the app
Source text + "answer only from it, otherwise say you
Guides format for this request only; no retraining
